description: Shows each scheduled probe file's last Prometheus scrape and last file update in one table.

options.content:
### Freshness check

- **Last scrape** is the latest Prometheus sample time for the job that reads each file. **Last updated** is the file's modification time. Different jobs scrape at different intervals; Last scrape is blank when no sample exists in the past 36 hours.
- If Last scrape advances while Last updated stays old, check the probe or timer. AP Web, Router, Wi-Fi, internet speed, and LAN Map files become stale after **24 hours** without an update; the daily SSD SMART file has a **30-hour** limit, and the one-minute Pi throttling file has a **10-minute** limit.
- The manually run energy import is excluded. Stale files appear in the count above and in Prometheus **Alerts**. No notification receiver is configured. Missing files are outside this check.
- When adding a probe or monitored file, update the Prometheus freshness rules, this dashboard, and the README.

targets.expr: max by (file) (label_replace(max by (job) (max_over_time(timestamp(home_ap_web_probe_success{job="ap-web"})[36h:1m])), "file", "/textfile/ap-web.prom", "job", ".*") or label_replace(max by (job) (max_over_time(timestamp(home_router_probe_success{job="router"})[36h:1m])), "file", "/textfile/router.prom", "job", ".*") or label_replace(max by (job) (max_over_time(timestamp(home_internet_speedtest_probe_success{job="internet-speed"})[36h:1m])), "file", "/textfile/internet-speed.prom", "job", ".*") or label_replace(max by (job) (max_over_time(timestamp(home_ssd_smart_probe_success{job="ssd-smart"})[36h:1m])), "file", "/textfile/ssd-smart.prom", "job", ".*") or label_replace(max by (job) (max_over_time(timestamp(home_pi_throttling_probe_success{job="raspberry-pi"})[36h:1m])), "file", "/textfile/pi-throttling.prom", "job", ".*") or label_replace(max by (job) (max_over_time(timestamp(home_lan_map_nodes{job="raspberry-pi"})[36h:1m])), "file", "/textfile/lan-map.prom", "job", ".*") or label_replace(max by (target) (max_over_time(timestamp(home_wifi_probe_success{job="raspberry-pi"})[36h:1m])), "file", "/textfile/wifi-$1.prom", "target", "(.*)")) * 1000

title: Probe Freshness
